description: This header file defines the MetalSpatialTensor class, which encapsulates GPU tensor data for Metal API, including buffer and texture management, tensor descriptors, and associated GPU resource functions within TensorFlow Lite delegates for GPU on Metal.

classes.name: MetalSpatialTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates GPU buffer and texture resources for spatial tensors used in Metal backend, providing tensor descriptor management, resource creation, and data transfer functionalities.

methods.name: GetGPUResources
methods.description: Returns GPU resources associated with this tensor, such as buffers or textures, for rendering or compute operations.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width dimension of the tensor.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height dimension of the tensor.

methods.name: Depth
methods.description: Returns the depth dimension of the tensor.

methods.name: Channels
methods.description: Returns the number of channels in the tensor.

methods.name: Slices
methods.description: Returns the number of slices, based on channel count divided by 4.

methods.name: Batch
methods.description: Returns the batch size of the tensor.

methods.name: GetDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor elements.

methods.name: GetStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type used for the tensor.

methods.name: GetMemorySizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the tensor memory in bytes.

methods.name: CreateFromDescriptor
methods.description: Initializes the tensor from a descriptor, allocating necessary GPU resources.

methods.name: UploadDescriptorData
methods.description: Uploads tensor data to GPU from descriptor data.

methods.name: ToDescriptor
methods.description: Fills a tensor descriptor with current tensor info.

methods.name: SetBufferHandle
methods.description: Sets the underlying MTLBuffer handle for the tensor.

methods.name: GetBufferHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the MTLBuffer handle associated with the tensor.
